description: This file implements OpenTelemetry integration for the litellm framework, providing tracing, logging, and metrics collection capabilities. It defines classes and functions to configure, initialize, and emit spans, logs, and metrics for distributed tracing and observability, including support for context propagation, dynamic headers, and custom attributes.

classes.name: OpenTelemetryConfig
classes.description: Data class representing configuration options for the OpenTelemetry integration, including exporter type, endpoint, headers, and metrics/events enable flags. Provides method from_env() to initialize configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: _get_litellm_resource()
methods.description: Creates and merges OpenTelemetry resource attributes respecting environment variables. Used for setting resource context in traces and metrics.

methods.name: from_env(cls)
methods.description: Reads environment variables to create an OpenTelemetryConfig instance with appropriate exporter, endpoint, headers, and feature flags.

methods.name: OpenTelemetry.__init__
methods.description: Initializes OpenTelemetry instrumentation, including tracing, logging, and metrics. Sets up tracer provider, log provider, and configures spans and attributes.

methods.name: _init_tracing(self, tracer_provider)
methods.description: Configures the tracer provider, either by using existing one or creating a new instance with resource attributes. Sets the global tracer provider.

methods.name: _init_metrics(self, meter_provider)
methods.description: Sets up metrics collection with optional OTLP exporter, creating histograms for various performance metrics if enabled.

methods.name: _init_logs(self, logger_provider)
methods.description: Configures the logging provider for OpenTelemetry, attaching batch processors if needed.

methods.name: log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a successful event by creating spans and recording metrics, attributes, and optional semantic logs.

methods.name: log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a failure event similar to success, with error status and exception recording.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronous version of log success event.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronous version of log failure event.

methods.name: async_service_success_hook( self, payload: ServiceLoggerPayload, parent_otel_span: Optional[Span] = None, start_time: Optional[Union[datetime, float]] = None, end_time: Optional[Union[datetime, float]] = None, event_metadata: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously commits service span data on success, including setting attributes and annotations.

methods.name: async_service_failure_hook( self, payload: ServiceLoggerPayload, error: Optional[str] = "", parent_otel_span: Optional[Span] = None, start_time: Optional[Union[datetime, float]] = None, end_time: Optional[Union[float, datetime]] = None, event_metadata: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously commits span data on failure, including error status and exception recording.

methods.name: async_post_call_failure_hook( self, request_data: dict, original_exception: Exception, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, traceback_str: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Logs exceptions and errors during proxy calls, ending spans with error status.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response: LLMResponseTypes, )
methods.description: Logs successful proxy call spans and appends attributes.

methods.name: Tracer get_tracer_to_use_for_request(self, kwargs: dict)
methods.description: Selects appropriate tracer for the request, possibly creating a temporary tracer if dynamic headers are used.

methods.name: Optional[dict] _get_dynamic_otel_headers_from_kwargs(self, kwargs)
methods.description: Extracts dynamic headers from callback parameters for team/key based logging.

methods.name: _get_tracer_with_dynamic_headers(self, dynamic_headers: dict)
methods.description: Creates a temporary tracer with custom resource attributes for the current request.

methods.name: Optional[dict] construct_dynamic_otel_headers( self, standard_callback_dynamic_params: StandardCallbackDynamicParams )
methods.description: Placeholder method intended for override to generate dynamic headers for team/key-based tracing.

methods.name: _handle_success(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Handles the creation of spans, metrics, and logs upon successful completion of a request.

methods.name: _start_primary_span( self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time, context, parent_span: Optional[Span] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a primary span with attributes based on request and response data.

methods.name: _maybe_log_raw_request( self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time, parent_span )
methods.description: Optionally logs raw request and response data for in-depth debugging.

methods.name: _record_metrics(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Records various metrics such as duration, tokens, and costs, based on the response timing and usage.

methods.name: Optional[float] _to_timestamp(val: Optional[Union[datetime, float, str]])
methods.description: Converts datetime, float, or string into a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: _record_time_to_first_token_metric(self, kwargs: dict, common_attrs: dict)
methods.description: Records latency from API call start to first token, for streaming requests.

methods.name: _record_time_per_output_token_metric( self, kwargs: dict, response_obj: Optional[Any], end_time: datetime, duration_s: float, common_attrs: dict, )
methods.description: Calculates and records time per output token, for both streaming and non-streaming requests.

methods.name: _record_response_duration_metric( self, kwargs: dict, end_time: Union[datetime, float], common_attrs: dict, )
methods.description: Records total response duration in seconds based on timing info.

methods.name: _emit_semantic_logs(self, kwargs, response_obj, span: Span)
methods.description: Emits detailed logs to OpenTelemetry for message prompts, completions, and other events.

methods.name: _create_guardrail_span( self, kwargs: Optional[dict], context: Optional[Context] )
methods.description: Creates spans for guardrail activities, recording related attributes.

methods.name: _handle_failure(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Records span and error information upon request failure, including exception details.

methods.name: _record_exception_on_span(self, span: Span, kwargs: dict)
methods.description: Attaches exception and structured error details to spans for observability.

methods.name: set_tools_attributes(self, span: Span, tools)
methods.description: Sets span attributes related to tools and functions used in the prompt.

methods.name: Union[str,bool,int,float] cast_as_primitive_value_type(self, value)
methods.description: Ensures attribute values are of primitive types supported by OTEL, converting complex objects to strings.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _tool_calls_kv_pair( tool_calls: List[ChatCompletionMessageToolCall], )
methods.description: Extracts key-value pairs from tool call objects for span attributes.

methods.name: set_attributes( self, span: Span, kwargs, response_obj: Optional[Any] )
methods.description: Sets detailed span attributes based on request parameters, response data, and callback context.

methods.name: Union[str,bool,int,float] _cast_as_primitive_value_type(self, value)
methods.description: Copies the primitive casting logic for internal use, ensuring attribute values are compatible with OTEL.

methods.name: safe_set_attribute(self, span: Span, key: str, value: Any)
methods.description: Sets an attribute on a span, converting the value into a primitive type safely.

methods.name: set_raw_request_attributes(self, span: Span, kwargs, response_obj)
methods.description: Adds request and response details to spans for raw data inspection.

methods.name: _to_ns(self, dt)
methods.description: Converts a datetime object to a nanoseconds timestamp.

methods.name: _get_span_name(self, kwargs)
methods.description: Determines span name based on metadata or default request span name.

methods.name: get_traceparent_from_header(self, headers)
methods.description: Extracts trace context from HTTP headers.

methods.name: _get_span_context(self, kwargs, default_span: Optional[Span] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs span context from headers or explicit span metadata.

methods.name: _get_tracer_with_dynamic_headers
methods.description: Creates a tracer with custom resource attributes for dynamic headers based on team and key info.
